response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.cnt), 0) AS total_rentals FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental WHERE CAST(return_date AS CHAR) > '2005-07-13 08:35:51' AND CAST(return_date AS CHAR) < '2005-08-09 05:58:16' GROUP BY customer_id) AS t;

assumptions.assumption: The window is compared as text by casting return_date to CHAR, so the comparison is on 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, as the request specifies. Both endpoints are excluded, so the comparisons are strict.
Rentals with a NULL return_date are excluded, since a NULL cast to text never satisfies either comparison.
The sum of per-customer counts equals the total number of matching rental rows, so the outer SUM is taken over the grouped counts. COALESCE returns 0 rather than NULL when no rental matches.
